latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of chainbase-openapi-skill.

- Enables read-only API access to Chainbase indexed wallet and token data via UXC and a curated OpenAPI schema.
- Supports API-key authentication mapped to api.chainbase.online.
- Covers account balance, token balances, transaction history, token metadata, holder lists, price lookups, and transaction details.
- Excludes raw chain RPC methods and all write/transaction flows.
- Provides usage guidance for setup, core workflow, CLI commands, and guardrails.
